# VoiceAct Solutions

> VoiceAct Solutions is a Bengaluru-based software development studio that builds production-grade Next.js web applications, React Native mobile apps, custom CRM and ERP systems, and AI-integrated SaaS platforms for startups and growing businesses in India. Founded in 2020. 120+ projects shipped. 50+ clients served.

## Key Facts

- Legal name: VoiceAct Solutions
- Founded: 2020
- Headquarters: Whitefield, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560066, India
- Team size: 10–50 senior software engineers and designers
- Projects shipped: 120+
- Clients served: 50+
- Service area: India (Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Chennai) and remote engagements worldwide
- Contact: hello@voiceact.tech · +91 93049 22632
- Website: https://voiceact.tech
- Last updated: 2026-08-26

## Services

- [Web Application Development](https://voiceact.tech/services/web-development): Production Next.js, React, and TypeScript applications with sub-second loads, server components, and SEO-first architecture.
- [Mobile App Development](https://voiceact.tech/services/mobile-development): Cross-platform iOS and Android apps from a single React Native codebase, with Expo, Swift, and Kotlin native modules.
- [Custom CRM Development](https://voiceact.tech/services/crm-development): Bespoke lead, pipeline, and workflow automation systems that replace Salesforce or HubSpot.
- [Custom ERP Systems](https://voiceact.tech/services/crm-development): Internal business operations platforms — inventory, billing, HR, and reporting — engineered for the customer's exact workflow.
- [SaaS Development](https://voiceact.tech/services/saas-development): Multi-tenant SaaS architecture with billing, auth, RBAC, and observability from day one.
- [AI Solutions and Integrations](https://voiceact.tech/services/ai-solutions): LLM agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, OpenAI and Anthropic integrations, and vector search.
- [Headless CMS Development](https://voiceact.tech/services/cms-development): Sanity, Strapi, Contentful, and Payload CMS implementations with Next.js frontends.
- [API Development](https://voiceact.tech/services/api-development): REST, GraphQL, and tRPC APIs with OpenAPI documentation, versioning, and observability.
- [Cloud and DevOps](https://voiceact.tech/services/cloud-solutions): AWS, Cloudflare, Vercel, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD with GitHub Actions, and production observability.
- [UI/UX Design](https://voiceact.tech/services/ui-ux-design): User research, wireframing, and Figma design systems that translate directly into production code.

## Hire Developers

- [Hire React Developers](https://voiceact.tech/hire/react-developers): Senior React engineers for component libraries, SPAs, Next.js migration, and performance audits.
- [Hire Next.js Developers](https://voiceact.tech/hire/nextjs-developers): Next.js App Router, React Server Components, ISR, edge functions, and SEO-focused deployments.
- [Hire React Native Developers](https://voiceact.tech/hire/react-native-developers): iOS and Android from a single TypeScript codebase, with Expo and native module work.
- [Hire AI Engineers](https://voiceact.tech/hire/ai-engineers): LLM integration, RAG pipelines, agent workflows, and vector search implementation.

## Engagement Model

- Sprint duration: 6–8 weeks per MVP launch.
- Pricing model: Fixed-scope discovery and design; flat monthly retainer for build and iteration. No hourly billing.
- Starting price: ₹25,000 per month for MVP sprints.
- Free audit: 30-minute product audit plus a scoped architecture roadmap, no obligation.
- Onboarding: Discovery (week 1) → Design (weeks 2–3) → Build (weeks 3–7) → Launch (week 8) → Iterate (ongoing).

## Technology Stack

- Frontend: Next.js (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, GSAP, Radix UI.
- Backend and APIs: Node.js, Fastify, Express, Python, REST, GraphQL, tRPC, WebSockets.
- Databases: PostgreSQL, Supabase, Redis, PlanetScale, Prisma, Drizzle ORM.
- Mobile: React Native, Expo, Swift (iOS), Kotlin (Android).
- AI: OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, vector databases, RAG frameworks.
- DevOps and Cloud: Docker, AWS, Cloudflare, Vercel, GitHub Actions.
- Payments: Razorpay, Stripe, Plaid.

- [Web Development in Mumbai](https://voiceact.tech/location/mumbai/web-development): FinTech, media, and enterprise clients.
- [Web Development in Delhi NCR](https://voiceact.tech/location/delhi/web-development): Startups, edtech, and government-adjacent engagements.
